findings.description: The tool fixture mines at y=-59, which needs break_blocks_in_negative_y. In HARD that threshold (42) is above use_golden_tools (38), so the HARD golden lock is masked and unproven for that config. A fixture at positive Y (break_blocks 34) would also be masked, but less often. This is not fatal, because the golden lock is proven in the other configs.

Only pickaxe mining is exercised per material. The guard also covers swords, axes, shovels, hoes and spears (AxeItem/HoeItem/ShovelItem/KineticWeapon/PiercingWeapon transforms), and none of these routes has runtime evidence.

Locked excerpts show ATD_EVENT LEFT_CLICK_BLOCK blockResult=ALLOW, and STATE reports the tool ability as null. The denial shows only as an unbroken block plus inventory resync, with no explicit server deny line or lock state.
